_comment: TEMPLATE. In production, set secrets via environment variables (e.g. Databases__PostgreSql__Password, Jwt__Key, Cloudinary__ApiSecret, AdminSeed__Password). NEVER commit secrets.

Cors._comment: The only environment where the CORS policy is applied (in Development the dev server proxies requests — see Program.cs). In production, set it via env var: indexed form (Cors__AllowedOrigins__0=https://your-domain) OR a single comma/semicolon-separated string in Cors__AllowedOriginsCsv (e.g. Cors__AllowedOriginsCsv=https://a.vercel.app,https://b.com). No trailing slash, and no localhost origins.

Auth._comment: PermitLimit/WindowSeconds are per IP. Lockout* is per account, independent of IP.

ForwardedHeaders._comment: Networks from which X-Forwarded-For is trusted. On Render the edge reaches the container over the private network. Outside these ranges the header is ignored (a safe failure mode).
